name: Gnome Improvement
summary: In Ironforge, Talvash del Kissel offers to improve a ring he made in Gnomeregan. He needs silver and moss agate for a delicate lattice over its old band.

sections.title: A Gnomish Artisan in Exile
sections.body: Talvash del Kissel fled Gnomeregan after the trogg invasion and radiation brought the city down. Now the gnome refugee lives in Ironforge's Mystic Ward. The jeweler and tinkerer is short on coin and out of stock, but determined to prove his skills remain sharp in exile.

sections.title: Upgrading the Old Band
sections.body: Talvash is glad to see his simple ring design again, cleaned by the Sparklematic 5200. Yet he considers the old band dated. He offers to improve it with silver and moss agate lattice work, showing his skill with metal and gemstones.

faq.answer: Talvash del Kissel is a gnome jeweler and craftsman living in exile in Ironforge. Before Gnomeregan fell, he ran a small jewelry shop there. One of his rings can be recovered and brought to him in the Mystic Ward.

faq.q: What is the history behind the ring being upgraded?
aliases: where does the ring come from
faq.answer: Talvash made the ring as one of several plain bands in his Gnomeregan shop. A Dark Iron dwarf carried one into the ruins, where adventurers can retrieve it and clean it in the Sparklematic 5200. Talvash offers to add silver and moss agate lattice work to improve it.

faq.q: Why does Talvash ask the player to provide the reagents?
aliases: why do i need silver and moss agate
why does talvash have no materials
faq.answer: Talvash ran out of materials and is short on money after fleeing Gnomeregan. He asks for silver and moss agate to make the lattice work.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain begin?
faq.answer: The trail begins in Gnomeregan, where a Grime-Encrusted Ring can be found on enemies. Clean it in the Sparklematic 5200, then follow the initials 'TdK' to Talvash in Ironforge.

faq.q: Is Talvash bitter about his situation in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Talvash laments his unjust financial hole, but keeps his spirits and professional pride. He believes that once back on his feet, he will be renowned across Azeroth for crafting the finest trinkets.

faq.q: Does the Horde have access to this quest?
faq.answer: No. Horde adventurers who clean Grime-Encrusted objects in Gnomeregan are sent to Nogg in Orgrimmar instead of Talvash in Ironforge.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see Talvash's pride in his craft, even after exile from his homeland and the loss of his materials.
As a miner, you can provide the silver and moss agate Talvash needs for his jewelry work.
As an Alliance adventurer, you can help refugees from Gnomeregan through the ties between the fallen capital and Ironforge.
